# Statements GetObjects sends at this depth, sorted. Regenerate with -update.

## no filters: 2 statement(s), 1 IN ACCOUNT
    <queries/get_objects_terse_catalogs.sql>
        CATALOG="%" DB_SCHEMA="%" TABLE="%" COLUMN="%" PK_QUERY_ID="" FK_QUERY_ID="" UNIQUE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_DB_QUERY_ID="<id>" SHOW_SCHEMA_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_TABLE_QUERY_ID="" SHOW_COLUMNS_QUERY_ID=""
    SHOW TERSE /* ADBC:getObjects */ DATABASES IN ACCOUNT
